answer: A ridge monitoring service must stop one seismic pulse from becoming a ripple of cloned agents claiming free compute. Issue signed, prepaid service vouchers with unique serials and fixed compute budgets. Each request atomically spends a voucher in a shared ledger; delegated sub-vouchers debit the parent's remaining budget. Copies and new agent names cannot increase that budget or redeem a serial twice. More consumption requires more purchased capacity. This bounds resource abuse without proving unique identities, provided all service nodes enforce the same spend ledger.
